name: refresh-retry-flag

question.prompt: fetchWithAuth gets a 401 because the access token expired. What happens next, and what stops it from looping forever if refresh() also fails to fix it?
question.answerKey: It calls refresh() and calls itself once more with retried = true. A second 401 is returned to the caller because the retried flag skips the refresh branch.
rubric: calls refresh() and retries the request
the retried flag stops a second refresh, so a second 401 is returned

answers.text: It refreshes the token and tries again once. The second call has retried=true, so if it is still 401 it just returns that response.
refresh, then recursive call with retried true; that flag means no second refresh, the 401 goes back to the caller
It refreshes the token and retries until the request succeeds.
It throws an error so the caller can log the user out.
